title: Decide push timing for accumulated session commits
description:
Operational decision. As of 2026-05-12 the local main branch is 7 commits ahead of origin/main:

  970bad6 docs: clarify server-side authorization model
  38055ec docs: clarify per-method auth latitude
  9344aec refactor: implementation-defined emoji authorization
  c93e545 refactor: implementation-defined Space governance
  b1e639b docs: update JMAP Quotas reference to RFC 9425
  80d5e11 refactor: drop per-aggregate caps, use overQuota
  4dc8fd7 docs: update references — replace superseded drafts with published RFCs, update emailpush to -03

Four of these (970bad6, 38055ec, 9344aec, c93e545) are from the 2026-05-12 session. The other three are older but also not yet pushed.

Decision: push now (sooner is easier to review), wait for more work to accumulate (single push for related changes), or stage by topic (push the governance/auth set as one push, then continue working).

Closing condition: push command runs and origin/main matches local main, OR an explicit policy is recorded for why the delay continues.
acceptance_criteria:
- Decision made and acted upon: either git push runs, or the bead records the reason for continued delay
- If pushed, the bead is closed with the push timestamp and resulting origin/main SHA
close_reason: Mark pushes 26-commit batch after session ends; agent does not push.
